prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Find and seize the object. Move it to destination. Check its properties. Scan area if necessary. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectToDestination    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO MoveObjectToDestination
		DO CheckObjectProperties
	END
